verdict.rationale: Brex documents receipt upload with automatic matching to existing expenses via the Expenses API (pre-signed S3 upload, "we will try to match the receipt"). Its AI assistants are claimed to fetch receipts for employees. That covers the filing-against-the-right-transaction half of the story, but the employee-facing capture channels and the OCR step are not evidenced. missing for 10: photo capture from the mobile app, email-forwarding receipt intake, explicit OCR/data extraction from receipts, independent or hands-on corroboration of matching accuracy.
